value: How do cognitive load, perceived usability (TAM), and ARCS motivation jointly shape students' learning attitudes and their intention to keep learning in STEAM education?

A questionnaire study of university and elementary students after an AI-based micro:bit STEAM activity fits a PLS-SEM model in which cognitive load lowers perceived usability, ARCS motivation raises attitude, and perceived usability both predicts continuous learning intention and moderates the attitude-to-intention path.

quote: The data collection period was from February to May 2021, and 145 questionnaire responses were collected, yielding 141 valid responses.
The results showed that perceived usability directly influenced learning intention and strengthened the relationship between learning attitudes and intention.
